laneClaim.command: node scripts/lane-claim.mjs claim --lane g130-flood-determination --seat cente-g130 --plan-row G-130 --dispatch _dispatches/2026-09-14_g130-flood-determination_dispatch.md

missionUnderstood: Recommend, do not build: which of two named flood-zone derivations (atoms:flood-hazard-fact centroid point-in-polygon vs pls:node-facets:tier2 tile-centre live FEMA query) is authoritative. Measure disagreement rate with denominator, trace both to every consumer, determine if the wire-drop of tier2.flood is deliberate, state which is right, and address the vintage gap. No sub-agents (single worker). No repo/store/serving-path changes.
initialPlan: Read AGENT_CONTRACT.md / DEV_PROCESS.md sections for checkpoint and close schema requirements
Read hauska-engine bff-flow.ts and subject-registry.ts at origin/main to confirm the dispatch's cited mechanism verbatim
Find and read any existing sweep artifacts for a real county (found: artifacts/ss-w11/flood-48021.json, flood-48453.json)
Trace consumers across hauska-map (PE), hauska-mcp-server (MCP catalog), legacy-design-tools (cortex/record path), and check for a plan-review consumer
Determine which store is right via ground-truth adjudication (prefer an existing independent adjudication over re-deriving one)
Check vintage/edition fields on both stores
Write the recommendation doc + CP2 + close
methodNote: All repo reads via git show/grep against fetched origin/main refs, no working tree checked out or modified, per ENUMERATE-BEFORE-ASSERTING-ABSENCE and code-reading-outranks-output-measuring doctrine.
openRisks: Dispatch's own cited file (hauska-engine bff-flow.ts) is a vendored reproduction pinned to a named SHA (d3510a6) about a month old at time of dispatch; real production code in hauska-map/legacy-design-tools may have moved past it -- flagged for verification before trusting the two-store framing as current.
